title: Page 32 spiral-turn versus payload-page-boundary holdout

target.description: Correspondence between six exact spiral-turn positions and six internal payload-page-boundary blocks

summary: Four of six spiral turns overlapped the six boundary-containing blocks, but the exact upper-tail p-value was 0.091908092 and failed the frozen 0.01 threshold.
why_run: To distinguish a visually suggestive Page 32 overlap from a statistically admissible structural correspondence.

pipeline.description: Calculate overlap of the two frozen six-position subsets and the exact hypergeometric upper tail over all six-position subsets of sixteen.

controls: No shifted turn definition, final-cell addition, block reordering, or line-boundary substitution was allowed.
The turn and page-boundary positions were frozen before scoring.
interpretation: The exact tested turn/boundary correspondence is rejected at the frozen threshold despite a visually suggestive overlap.
limitations: This rejects only the exact positionwise definition and threshold.
The full rune transcription and forward next-slice instructions are excluded from the public package.

normalization_changes: Converted historical fields to the HMS run schema.
Preserved the contract, report, result, and ledger as normalized UTF-8 text.
Excluded the full rune transcription and forward next-slice instructions.

raw_artifacts.reason: All quantitative evidence used by the public claim is present; corpus text and forward instructions are excluded.
